verdict.rationale: Fedora's own docs claim you can install the best desktop apps with the click of a button from Fedora's repositories and Flathub, and easily install, update and manage software. However, a hands-on switcher reported that installing popular apps such as Discord and Spotify took a page of commands, still didn't run quite right, and some installed GUI apps had to be added to the menu via the command line. That report directly contradicts the one-click claim for exactly the apps this story targets. missing for 10: named documentation of the built-in store app itself, independent confirmation that popular proprietary apps install in one click, resolution of the reported command-line requirement.
